title: Weather Label (Ternary)
hints: Start with two labels: temperature > 30 ? "Hot" : "Not hot".
Replace the second value with another ternary: ... : temperature < 10 ? "Cold" : "Mild".
Check the boundaries: 30 is Mild, 31 is Hot, 10 is Mild, 9 is Cold.

mustContain.message: Use the ternary operator: condition ? valueIfTrue : valueIfFalse.

mustNotContain.message: Solve it with the ternary operator instead of if / else.
